clock.method: max over window of (server ts - browser receive time); error = min one-way delay

spectrogram.doc: dbQ_base64 = base64 of uint8[nColumns*nBins], row-major (one column of 256 Doppler bins after another). dB = dbMin + q*(dbMax-dbMin)/255. tServerMs = Ubuntu time (ms) of the END of each column's 200 ms window.
